Ravi (Docs): quick FYI — spotted three small but important issues in the SDK examples PR: streaming snippet doesn't show cleanup, TS retry lacks maxDelay/attempt limits, Go pagination can loop on empty cursors.
May (SDK): can you paste the offending snippets?
Ravi (Docs): Python current example: 
```py
async for c in client.stream(prompt):
  print(c)
```
That can leave background tasks open. Suggest: 
```py
async with client.stream(prompt) as s:
  async for c in s:
    print(c)
```
and fallback for older SDKs: call `await client.close()` after iterating.
Ivy L: TS patch suggestion: add conservative defaults — base=200, factor=2, maxDelay=4000, attempts=6, jitter true. Also show abort on 4xx.
May (SDK): OK. For Go, current loop: 
```go
resp, _ := client.List(ctx, nil)
for resp.HasMore() {
  resp, _ = client.List(ctx, resp.NextCursor())
}
```
If NextCursor()=="" some backends repeat first page. Proposed: 
```go
resp, _ := client.List(ctx, nil)
for {
  if !resp.HasMore() { break }
  next := resp.NextCursor()
  if next == "" { break }
  resp, _ = client.List(ctx, next)
}
```
DevX Bot: running link-check on branch docs/snippet-fixes...
DevX Bot: found 1 broken link: /guides/old-retries -> replace with /guides/retries-patterns.
Ravi (Docs): I'll update examples, add a tiny Go unit test that simulates empty cursor, and patch the link. Requesting review from @May and @Ivy.
May (SDK): quick pass looks good. Add a one-line comment in each snippet explaining the safety guard.
Ivy L: approved once CI green.
Ravi (Docs): pushed changes. CI queued. Thanks all! If anyone sees other example oddities, flag here or open a micro-PR.
